name: negLog_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma negLog_zero : negLog (0 : Mᵐ⁰) = ⊤

name: negLog_exp
statement: @[simp] lemma negLog_exp (m : M) : negLog (exp m) = ((-m : M) : WithTop M)

name: negLog_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma negLog_eq_top {x : Mᵐ⁰} : negLog x = ⊤ ↔ x = 0

name: negLog_one
statement: @[simp] lemma negLog_one : negLog (1 : Mᵐ⁰) = 0

name: negLog_eq_coe
statement: lemma negLog_eq_coe {x : Mᵐ⁰} {m : M} : negLog x = (m : WithTop M) ↔ x = exp (-m)
doc: /-- The characterisation of `negLog`: `negLog x = m` if and only if `x = exp (-m)`. -/

name: negLog_mul
statement: lemma negLog_mul (x y : Mᵐ⁰) : negLog (x * y) = negLog x + negLog y

name: negLog_le_negLog
statement: lemma negLog_le_negLog {x y : Mᵐ⁰} : negLog x ≤ negLog y ↔ y ≤ x

name: negLog_lt_negLog
statement: lemma negLog_lt_negLog {x y : Mᵐ⁰} : negLog x < negLog y ↔ y < x

name: orderAddIsoWithTop
statement: def orderAddIsoWithTop : (Additive Mᵐ⁰)ᵒᵈ ≃+o WithTop M where

name: orderAddIsoWithTop_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma orderAddIsoWithTop_apply (x : (Additive Mᵐ⁰)ᵒᵈ) :
    orderAddIsoWithTop M x = negLog x

name: mapAddHom'_exp
statement: @[simp] lemma mapAddHom'_exp (f : M →+ N) (m : M) : mapAddHom' f (exp m) = exp (f m)

name: mapAddHom'_strictMono
statement:
lemma mapAddHom'_strictMono [Preorder M] [Preorder N] {f : M →+ N} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    StrictMono (mapAddHom' f)

name: negLog_mapAddHom'
statement:
lemma negLog_mapAddHom' (f : M →+ N) (x : Mᵐ⁰) :
    negLog (mapAddHom' f x) = WithTop.map f (negLog x)
doc: /-- `negLog` is natural in `M`. -/

name: toRealMultZero
statement: noncomputable def toRealMultZero : ℝ≥0 →*₀ ℝᵐ⁰ where
doc:
/-- The order-preserving monoid-with-zero hom `ℝ≥0 →*₀ ℝᵐ⁰` sending `0` to `0` and `x` to
`exp (log x)`. It is an isomorphism; only strict monotonicity is used. -/

name: toRealMultZero_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma toRealMultZero_of_ne_zero {x : ℝ≥0} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    toRealMultZero x = WithZero.exp (Real.log x)

name: toRealMultZero_strictMono
statement: lemma toRealMultZero_strictMono : StrictMono toRealMultZero

name: toNNReal
statement: noncomputable def toNNReal {e : ℝ≥0} (he : e ≠ 0) : ℝᵐ⁰ →*₀ ℝ≥0 where
doc:
/-- The real analogue of `WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal`: the hom `ℝᵐ⁰ →*₀ ℝ≥0` sending `0` to `0` and
`exp t` to `e ^ t` (an `NNReal.rpow`), for a base `e ≠ 0`. -/

name: toNNReal_exp
statement: @[simp] lemma toNNReal_exp {e : ℝ≥0} (he : e ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) : toNNReal he (exp t) = e ^ t

name: toNNReal_strictMono
statement:
lemma toNNReal_strictMono {e : ℝ≥0} (he : 1 < e) :
    StrictMono (toNNReal (ne_zero_of_lt he))

name: ratCoeff_eq
statement:
private lemma ratCoeff_eq (h : ∀ a : M, IsCommensurableWith a₀ a) (ha₀ : a₀ ≠ 0)
    {m n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : n • a = m • a₀) : ratCoeff h a = (m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ)

name: ratLog
statement:
noncomputable def ratLog (ha₀ : a₀ < 0) (h : ∀ a : M, IsCommensurableWith a₀ a) :
    M →+ ℚ where
doc:
/-- **The `ℚ`-valued logarithm normalised at `a₀`.** If `a₀ < 0` and every element of `M` is
commensurable with `a₀`, this is the unique additive hom `M →+ ℚ` sending `a₀` to `-1`. -/

name: ratLog_eq
statement:
lemma ratLog_eq (ha₀ : a₀ < 0) (h : ∀ a : M, IsCommensurableWith a₀ a) {m n : ℤ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : n • a = m • a₀) : ratLog ha₀ h a = -((m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ))

name: ratLog_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma ratLog_self (ha₀ : a₀ < 0) (h : ∀ a : M, IsCommensurableWith a₀ a) :
    ratLog ha₀ h a₀ = -1

name: ratLog_strictMono
statement:
lemma ratLog_strictMono (ha₀ : a₀ < 0) (h : ∀ a : M, IsCommensurableWith a₀ a) :
    StrictMono (ratLog ha₀ h)

name: ratLog_unique
statement:
lemma ratLog_unique (ha₀ : a₀ < 0) (h : ∀ a : M, IsCommensurableWith a₀ a) (g : M →+ ℚ)
    (hg : g a₀ = -1) : g = ratLog ha₀ h
doc: /-- The `ℚ`-valued logarithm is the only additive hom `M →+ ℚ` sending `a₀` to `-1`. -/

name: addVal_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma addVal_apply (v : Valuation R Mᵐ⁰) (x : R) : v.addVal x = negLog (v x)

name: addVal_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma addVal_eq_top {v : Valuation R Mᵐ⁰} {x : R} : v.addVal x = ⊤ ↔ v x = 0

name: addVal_eq_coe
statement:
lemma addVal_eq_coe {v : Valuation R Mᵐ⁰} {x : R} {m : M} :
    v.addVal x = (m : WithTop M) ↔ v x = exp (-m)
doc: /-- The defining property: `v.addVal x = m` if and only if `v x = exp (-m)`. -/

name: addVal_le_addVal
statement:
lemma addVal_le_addVal {v : Valuation R Mᵐ⁰} {x y : R} :
    v.addVal x ≤ v.addVal y ↔ v y ≤ v x
doc: /-- The additive valuation reverses the order of the multiplicative one. -/

name: addVal_map
statement:
lemma addVal_map (v : Valuation R Mᵐ⁰) {f : M →+ N} (hf : StrictMono f) (x : R) :
    (v.map (mapAddHom' f) (mapAddHom'_strictMono hf).monotone).addVal x
      = WithTop.map f (v.addVal x)
doc: /-- Pushing a valuation along `mapAddHom' f` pushes its additive valuation along `f`. -/

name: addValValueGroup_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma addValValueGroup_apply (x : R) :
    v.addValValueGroup x = negLog (M := Additive (valueGroup (.ofClass v))) (v.restrict x)

name: addValValueGroup_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma addValValueGroup_eq_top {x : R} : v.addValValueGroup x = ⊤ ↔ v x = 0

name: addVal_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma addVal_apply (x : R) :
    addVal v x = negLog (NNReal.toRealMultZero (RankOne.hom v (v.restrict x)))

name: addVal_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma addVal_zero : addVal v 0 = ⊤

name: addVal_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma addVal_eq_top {x : R} : addVal v x = ⊤ ↔ v x = 0

name: addVal_apply_of_val_ne_zero
statement:
lemma addVal_apply_of_val_ne_zero {x : R} (hx : v x ≠ 0) :
    addVal v x = ((-Real.log (RankOne.hom v (v.restrict x)) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
doc: /-- On elements of nonzero valuation the real additive valuation is `-log ‖x‖`. -/

name: addVal_eq_of_hom_eq
statement:
lemma addVal_eq_of_hom_eq {w : Valuation R Γ₀} [RankOne w]
    (h : ∀ x, RankOne.hom v (v.restrict x) = RankOne.hom w (w.restrict x)) :
    addVal v = addVal w
doc:
/-- The real additive valuation only sees the real-valued absolute value: two rank-one valuations
with the same `hom ∘ restrict` (for instance, equivalent valuations with matching `hom`) have the
same real additive valuation. -/

name: IsCommensurable.val_ne_zero
statement: lemma IsCommensurable.val_ne_zero : v π ≠ 0

name: IsCommensurable.of_forall_eq
statement:
lemma IsCommensurable.of_forall_eq {w : Valuation R Γ₀} (h : ∀ x, w x = v x) :
    w.IsCommensurable π
doc: /-- Commensurability only depends on the values of the valuation. -/

name: IsCommensurable.isNontrivial
statement: lemma IsCommensurable.isNontrivial : v.IsNontrivial
doc: /-- A valuation with a normalising element is nontrivial. -/

name: coe_commGen
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_commGen : ((commGen v π : Γ₀ˣ) : Γ₀) = v π

name: ofMul_commGen_neg
statement: lemma ofMul_commGen_neg : Additive.ofMul (commGen v π) < 0

name: isCommensurableWith_commGen
statement:
lemma isCommensurableWith_commGen (g : valueGroup (.ofClass v)) :
    AddCommGroup.IsCommensurableWith (Additive.ofMul (commGen v π)) (Additive.ofMul g)
doc: /-- Every element of the value group is commensurable with the normalising element. -/

name: ratLog_strictMono
statement: lemma ratLog_strictMono : StrictMono (ratLog v π)

name: ratLog_commGen
statement: @[simp] lemma ratLog_commGen : ratLog v π (Additive.ofMul (commGen v π)) = -1

name: ratLog_eq_of_zsmul
statement:
lemma ratLog_eq_of_zsmul {g : valueGroup (.ofClass v)} {m n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hmn : n • Additive.ofMul g = m • Additive.ofMul (commGen v π)) :
    ratLog v π (Additive.ofMul g) = -((m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ))

name: addValQ_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma addValQ_apply (x : R) :
    v.addValQ π x = WithTop.map (ratLog v π) (v.addValValueGroup x)

name: addValQ_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma addValQ_zero : v.addValQ π 0 = ⊤

name: addValQ_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma addValQ_eq_top {x : R} : v.addValQ π x = ⊤ ↔ v x = 0

name: addValQ_eq_of_zpow
statement:
lemma addValQ_eq_of_zpow {x : R} {m n : ℤ} (hx : v x ≠ 0) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hmn : v x ^ n = v π ^ m) :
    v.addValQ π x = (((m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : WithTop ℚ)
doc: /-- **The workhorse.** A witness `v x ^ n = v π ^ m` computes the additive valuation. -/

name: addValQ_eq_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
lemma addValQ_eq_of_pow_eq_pow {x : R} {m n : ℕ} (hx : v x ≠ 0) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hmn : v x ^ n = v π ^ m) :
    v.addValQ π x = (((m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : WithTop ℚ)
doc: /-- The workhorse with natural exponents. -/

name: addValQ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma addValQ_self : v.addValQ π π = 1

name: addValQ_ne_top
statement: lemma addValQ_ne_top {x : R} (hx : v x ≠ 0) : v.addValQ π x ≠ ⊤

name: exists_zpow_eq_and_addValQ
statement:
lemma exists_zpow_eq_and_addValQ {x : R} (hx : v x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ, 0 < n ∧ v x ^ n = v π ^ m ∧
      v.addValQ π x = (((m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : WithTop ℚ)

name: addValQ_le_addValQ
statement: lemma addValQ_le_addValQ {x y : R} : v.addValQ π x ≤ v.addValQ π y ↔ v y ≤ v x

name: addValQ_unique
statement:
theorem addValQ_unique (w : AddValuation R (WithTop ℚ))
    (hw : ∀ x y, w x ≤ w y ↔ v y ≤ v x)
    (hwπ : w π = 1) : w = v.addValQ π
doc:
/-- **Uniqueness.** An additive valuation into `WithTop ℚ` inducing the same order on values as
`v` and sending `π` to `1` is `addValQ v π`: the element pins the valuation. -/

name: IsCommensurable.toRankLeOne
statement: noncomputable def IsCommensurable.toRankLeOne {e : ℝ≥0} (he : 1 < e) : RankLeOne v where
doc:
/-- **Rational rank one implies rank ≤ one.** For any base `1 < e`; the resulting norm satisfies
`‖π‖ = e⁻¹`. -/

name: IsCommensurable.toRankOne_hom_restrict
statement:
lemma IsCommensurable.toRankOne_hom_restrict {e : ℝ≥0} (he : 1 < e) :
    letI := IsCommensurable.toRankOne v π he
    RankOne.hom v (v.restrict π) = e⁻¹
doc:
/-- The rank-one structure of `IsCommensurable.toRankOne` gives the normalising element the
absolute value `e⁻¹`. -/

name: RankOne.addVal_eq_map_addValQ
statement:
theorem RankOne.addVal_eq_map_addValQ (x : R) :
    RankOne.addVal v x =
      WithTop.map (fun q : ℚ ↦ (q : ℝ) * (-Real.log (RankOne.hom v (v.restrict π))))
        (v.addValQ π x)
doc:
/-- **The compatibility square `ℚ → ℝ`.** For a rank-one valuation commensurable at `π`, the real
additive valuation `x ↦ -log ‖x‖` is the `ℚ`-valued one rescaled by `-log ‖π‖`. -/

name: RankOne.hom_eq_rpow_addValQ
doc:
/-- **`‖x‖ = ‖π‖ ^ q`.** The norm is the normalising element's norm raised to the `ℚ`-valued
additive valuation. No base, no factorisation hypothesis. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.exists_zpow_generator_eq
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.exists_zpow_generator_eq {x : R} (hx : v x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, v x = ((generator v ^ k : Γ₀ˣ) : Γ₀)
doc: /-- On a discrete valuation every nonzero value is an integer power of the generator. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.exists_zpow_eq_of_isUniformizer
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.exists_zpow_eq_of_isUniformizer {π : R} (hπ : IsUniformizer v π)
    {x : R} (hx : v x ≠ 0) : ∃ k : ℤ, v x = v π ^ k
doc:
/-- On a discrete valuation every nonzero value is an integer power of a uniformiser: the `n = 1`
case of commensurability. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.isCommensurable_of_lt_one
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.isCommensurable_of_lt_one {π : R} (h0 : v π ≠ 0) (h1 : v π < 1) :
    v.IsCommensurable π
doc:
/-- A discrete valuation is commensurable at every element of valuation strictly between `0`
and `1`. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.isCommensurable
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.isCommensurable {π : R} (hπ : IsUniformizer v π) :
    v.IsCommensurable π
doc:
/-- **`IsRankOneDiscrete ⟹ IsCommensurable` at any uniformiser.** A discrete valuation has
rational rank one, normalised at a uniformiser. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_apply (x : R) :
    addValZ v x = negLog (valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt v (v.restrict x))

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_zero : addValZ v 0 = ⊤

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_top {x : R} : addValZ v x = ⊤ ↔ v x = 0

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_iff
statement:
theorem IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_iff (x : R) (k : ℤ) :
    addValZ v x = (k : WithTop ℤ) ↔ v x = ((generator v ^ k : Γ₀ˣ) : Γ₀)
doc: /-- The characterisation of the `ℤ`-valued additive valuation by the generator. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_of_zpow
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_of_zpow {π : R} (hπ : IsUniformizer v π) {x : R} {k : ℤ}
    (hk : v x = v π ^ k) : addValZ v x = (k : WithTop ℤ)
doc: /-- A witness `v x = v π ^ k` at a uniformiser computes the `ℤ`-valued additive valuation. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_iff_of_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_eq_iff_of_isUniformizer {π : R} (hπ : IsUniformizer v π)
    (x : R) (k : ℤ) : addValZ v x = (k : WithTop ℤ) ↔ v x = v π ^ k
doc: /-- The characterisation of the `ℤ`-valued additive valuation by a uniformiser. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_isUniformizer {π : R} (hπ : IsUniformizer v π) :
    addValZ v π = 1
doc: /-- A uniformiser has `ℤ`-valued additive valuation `1`. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_le_addValZ
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.addValZ_le_addValZ {x y : R} :
    addValZ v x ≤ addValZ v y ↔ v y ≤ v x

name: addValQ_eq_map_addValZ
statement:
theorem addValQ_eq_map_addValZ {π : R} (hπ : IsUniformizer v π) [v.IsCommensurable π] (x : R) :
    v.addValQ π x = WithTop.map (fun n : ℤ ↦ (n : ℚ)) (addValZ v x)
doc:
/-- **Inclusion `WithTop ℤ → WithTop ℚ`.** For a discrete valuation normalised at a uniformiser,
the `ℚ`-valued additive valuation is the `ℤ`-valued one composed with `Int.cast`. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.hom_eq_toNNReal_comp
statement:
lemma IsRankOneDiscrete.hom_eq_toNNReal_comp [RankOne v] {e : ℝ≥0} (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hgen : RankOne.hom v (generator' v : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)) = e⁻¹) :
    RankOne.hom v =
      (WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal he).comp (.ofClass (valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt v))
doc:
/-- **The absolute value is determined by one scalar.** On a discrete valuation the value group is
infinite cyclic, so a `→*₀` hom out of it is determined by its value on the generator: if the
generator has absolute value `e⁻¹`, then `RankOne.hom v` is "`e` to the power" through
`valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt`. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.hom_eq_zpow_neg_addValZ
statement:
theorem IsRankOneDiscrete.hom_eq_zpow_neg_addValZ [RankOne v] {e : ℝ≥0} (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hgen : RankOne.hom v (generator' v : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)) = e⁻¹)
    {x : R} {d : ℤ} (hd : addValZ v x = (d : WithTop ℤ)) :
    RankOne.hom v (v.restrict x) = e ^ (-d)
doc:
/-- **The absolute value is the base to the power of minus the `ℤ`-valued additive valuation.**
If the generator has absolute value `e⁻¹` and `addValZ v x = d`, then `‖x‖ = e ^ (-d)`. -/

name: IsRankOneDiscrete.hom_eq_zpow_neg_addValZ_of_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem IsRankOneDiscrete.hom_eq_zpow_neg_addValZ_of_isUniformizer [RankOne v] {π : R}
    (hπ : IsUniformizer v π) {e : ℝ≥0} (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hπe : RankOne.hom v (v.restrict π) = e⁻¹)
    {x : R} {d : ℤ} (hd : addValZ v x = (d : WithTop ℤ)) :
    RankOne.hom v (v.restrict x) = e ^ (-d)
doc: /-- The same, with the scalar hypothesis read off a uniformiser. -/

name: addVal_apply_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma addVal_apply_of_ne_zero {x : L} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    addVal v x = ((-Real.log (v.norm x) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
doc: /-- On a field, the real additive valuation is literally `x ↦ -log ‖x‖`. -/

name: valuation_norm_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma valuation_norm_eq (x : K) : (valuation (K := K)).norm x = ‖x‖
doc: /-- The real-valued norm attached to `NormedField.valuation` is just `‖·‖`. -/

name: norm_eq_coe_hom
statement:
lemma norm_eq_coe_hom (x : K) :
    ‖x‖ = ((RankOne.hom (valuation (K := K)) ((valuation (K := K)).restrict x) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
doc: /-- The norm is the rank-one `hom` of the valuation, restricted to its value group. -/

name: normAddVal_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddVal_zero : normAddVal K 0 = ⊤

name: normAddVal_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddVal_eq_top {x : K} : normAddVal K x = ⊤ ↔ x = 0

name: normAddVal_apply_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma normAddVal_apply_of_ne_zero {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    normAddVal K x = ((-Real.log ‖x‖ : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)

name: exists_normAddVal_eq_and_norm_eq_exp_neg
statement:
lemma exists_normAddVal_eq_and_norm_eq_exp_neg {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, normAddVal K x = (r : WithTop ℝ) ∧ ‖x‖ = Real.exp (-r)
doc:
/-- **The defining equivalence**: on a nonzero element the real additive valuation is a real `r`
with `‖x‖ = exp (-r)`. -/

name: normAddVal_le_normAddVal
statement:
lemma normAddVal_le_normAddVal {x y : K} :
    normAddVal K x ≤ normAddVal K y ↔ ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖

name: normAddVal_unique
statement:
theorem normAddVal_unique (w : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ))
    (hw : ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → ∃ r : ℝ, w x = (r : WithTop ℝ) ∧ ‖x‖ = Real.exp (-r)) :
    w = normAddVal K
doc:
/-- **Uniqueness**: `normAddVal K` is the only additive valuation into `WithTop ℝ` satisfying the
defining equivalence `‖x‖ = exp (-(w x))` on nonzero elements. -/

name: normAddValZ_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddValZ_zero : normAddValZ K 0 = ⊤

name: normAddValZ_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddValZ_eq_top {x : K} : normAddValZ K x = ⊤ ↔ x = 0

name: normAddValZ_eq_iff_of_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem normAddValZ_eq_iff_of_isUniformizer {π : K} (hπ : IsUniformizer (valuation (K := K)) π)
    (x : K) (k : ℤ) : normAddValZ K x = (k : WithTop ℤ) ↔ ‖x‖ = ‖π‖ ^ k
doc: /-- The characterisation by a uniformiser: `normAddValZ K x = k ↔ ‖x‖ = ‖π‖ ^ k`. -/

name: normAddValZ_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem normAddValZ_isUniformizer {π : K} (hπ : IsUniformizer (valuation (K := K)) π) :
    normAddValZ K π = 1
doc: /-- A uniformiser has `ℤ`-valued additive valuation `1`. -/

name: norm_eq_zpow_neg_normAddValZ
statement:
theorem norm_eq_zpow_neg_normAddValZ {e : ℝ≥0} (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hgen : RankOne.hom (valuation (K := K))
      (IsRankOneDiscrete.generator' (valuation (K := K)) :
        ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass (valuation (K := K)))) = e⁻¹)
    {x : K} {d : ℤ} (hd : normAddValZ K x = (d : WithTop ℤ)) :
    ‖x‖ = (e : ℝ) ^ (-d)
doc:
/-- **The norm is the base to the power of minus the additive valuation.** If the generator of
the value group is `e⁻¹` and `normAddValZ K x = d`, then `‖x‖ = e ^ (-d)`. -/

name: norm_eq_zpow_neg_normAddValZ_of_isUniformizer
doc:
/-- **Norm recovery at a uniformiser**: if a uniformiser has norm `e⁻¹` and `normAddValZ K x = d`,
then `‖x‖ = e ^ (-d)`. For the standard `p`-adic norm `e = p`, so `‖x‖ = p ^ (-vₚ x)`. -/

name: normAddVal_eq_map_normAddValZ
statement:
theorem normAddVal_eq_map_normAddValZ {π : K} (hπ : IsUniformizer (valuation (K := K)) π)
    (x : K) :
    normAddVal K x
      = WithTop.map (fun k : ℤ ↦ (k : ℝ) * (-Real.log ‖π‖)) (normAddValZ K x)
doc:
/-- **The compatibility square `ℤ → ℝ`**: the real additive valuation is `-log ‖π‖` times the
`ℤ`-valued one, for a uniformiser `π`. -/

name: normAddValQ_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddValQ_zero : normAddValQ K π 0 = ⊤

name: normAddValQ_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddValQ_eq_top {x : K} : normAddValQ K π x = ⊤ ↔ x = 0

name: normAddValQ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma normAddValQ_self : normAddValQ K π π = 1

name: normAddValQ_eq_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
lemma normAddValQ_eq_of_pow_eq_pow {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) {m n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : ‖x‖ ^ n = ‖π‖ ^ m) :
    normAddValQ K π x = (((m : ℚ) / (n : ℚ) : ℚ) : WithTop ℚ)
doc: /-- The workhorse, read off the norm: `‖x‖ ^ n = ‖π‖ ^ m` computes `normAddValQ K π x = m / n`. -/

name: norm_eq_norm_rpow_normAddValQ
doc:
/-- **`‖x‖ = ‖π‖ ^ q`.** On an ultrametric normed field of rational rank one, the norm is the norm
of the normalising element raised to the `ℚ`-valued additive valuation. For `ℂ_p` with `π = p` this
reads `‖x‖ = p ^ (-v x)`. -/

name: normAddVal_eq_map_normAddValQ
statement:
theorem normAddVal_eq_map_normAddValQ (x : K) :
    normAddVal K x
      = WithTop.map (fun q : ℚ ↦ (q : ℝ) * (-Real.log ‖π‖)) (normAddValQ K π x)
doc:
/-- **The compatibility square `ℚ → ℝ`**: the real additive valuation is `-log ‖π‖` times the
`ℚ`-valued one normalised at `π`. -/

name: normAddValQ_eq_map_normAddValZ
statement:
theorem normAddValQ_eq_map_normAddValZ [(valuation (K := K)).IsRankOneDiscrete]
    (hπ : IsUniformizer (valuation (K := K)) π) (x : K) :
    normAddValQ K π x = WithTop.map (fun n : ℤ ↦ (n : ℚ)) (normAddValZ K x)
doc:
/-- **The compatibility square `ℤ → ℚ`**: on a discretely valued field normalised at a uniformiser,
the `ℚ`-valued additive valuation is the `ℤ`-valued one composed with `Int.cast`. -/

name: nnnorm_p_eq_inv
statement: lemma nnnorm_p_eq_inv : ‖(p : ℚ_[p])‖₊ = (p : ℝ≥0)⁻¹

name: nnnorm_p_ne_zero
statement: lemma nnnorm_p_ne_zero : ‖(p : ℚ_[p])‖₊ ≠ 0

name: nnnorm_p_zpow_valuation
statement:
lemma nnnorm_p_zpow_valuation {x : ℚ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ‖(p : ℚ_[p])‖₊ ^ x.valuation = ‖x‖₊

name: zpowers_valueGroupGen
statement: lemma zpowers_valueGroupGen : Subgroup.zpowers (valueGroupGen (p := p)) = ⊤

name: isCyclic_valueGroup
statement:
instance isCyclic_valueGroup :
    IsCyclic (valueGroup (.ofClass (NormedField.valuation (K := ℚ_[p]))))

name: isRankOneDiscrete_valuation
statement: theorem isRankOneDiscrete_valuation : (NormedField.valuation (K := ℚ_[p])).IsRankOneDiscrete
doc:
/-- The `p`-adic norm is a discrete rank-one valuation (through `IsRankOneDiscrete.mk'`: the value
group is cyclic by `isCyclic_valueGroup` and nontrivial because the norm is nontrivial). -/

name: coe_generator_eq
statement:
theorem coe_generator_eq :
    (generator (NormedField.valuation (K := ℚ_[p])) : ℝ≥0) = (p : ℝ≥0)⁻¹
doc: /-- The generator of the value group of the `p`-adic norm is `p⁻¹`. -/

name: isUniformizer_p
statement: theorem isUniformizer_p : IsUniformizer (NormedField.valuation (K := ℚ_[p])) (p : ℚ_[p])
doc: /-- `p` is a uniformiser of `ℚ_p`. -/

name: isCommensurable_p
statement: instance isCommensurable_p : (NormedField.valuation (K := ℚ_[p])).IsCommensurable (p : ℚ_[p])
doc:
/-- `p` is a normalising element of `ℚ_p`: the `ℚ`-valued additive valuation `normAddValQ ℚ_[p] p`
exists (and is `normAddValZ` composed with `Int.cast`). -/

name: norm_eq_zpow_neg_normAddValZ_padic
statement:
theorem norm_eq_zpow_neg_normAddValZ_padic {x : ℚ_[p]} {d : ℤ}
    (hd : normAddValZ ℚ_[p] x = (d : WithTop ℤ)) : ‖x‖ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-d)
doc: /-- **The `p`-adic norm is `p` to the power of minus the `ℤ`-valued additive valuation.** -/

name: normAddValZ_padic_apply
statement: theorem normAddValZ_padic_apply (x : ℚ_[p]) : normAddValZ ℚ_[p] x = Padic.addValuation x
doc: /-- **The verification, pointwise.** On `ℚ_p`, `normAddValZ` is Mathlib's `Padic.addValuation`. -/

name: normAddValZ_padic
statement: theorem normAddValZ_padic : normAddValZ ℚ_[p] = Padic.addValuation
doc:
/-- **The verification.** On `ℚ_p`, `normAddValZ` is Mathlib's `Padic.addValuation`, as additive
valuations. -/

name: valuation_eq_exp_neg_order
statement:
theorem valuation_eq_exp_neg_order {f : LaurentSeries K} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Valued.v f = exp (-f.order)
doc: /-- The valuation of a nonzero Laurent series is `exp (-order)`. -/

name: isRankOneDiscrete_valued
statement:
instance isRankOneDiscrete_valued :
    (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰).IsRankOneDiscrete
doc: /-- The `X`-adic valuation of `K⸨X⸩` is a discrete rank-one valuation. -/

name: generator_valued_eq
statement:
theorem generator_valued_eq :
    generator (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰)
      = Units.mk0 (exp (-1 : ℤ)) exp_ne_zero
doc: /-- The generator of the value group of `K⸨X⸩` is `exp (-1)`. -/

name: isUniformizer_X
statement:
theorem isUniformizer_X :
    IsUniformizer (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰)
      ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) : LaurentSeries K)
doc: /-- `X` is a uniformiser of `K⸨X⸩`. -/

name: addValZ_X
statement:
theorem addValZ_X :
    addValZ (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰)
      ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) : LaurentSeries K) = 1
doc: /-- `X` has `ℤ`-valued additive valuation `1`. -/

name: addValZ_single
statement:
theorem addValZ_single (s : ℤ) :
    addValZ (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰) (HahnSeries.single s (1 : K))
      = (s : WithTop ℤ)
doc: /-- The monomial `X ^ s` has `ℤ`-valued additive valuation `s`. -/

name: addValZ_eq_order
statement:
theorem addValZ_eq_order {f : LaurentSeries K} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    addValZ (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰) f = (f.order : WithTop ℤ)
doc: /-- **The `ℤ`-valued additive valuation of a Laurent series is its order of vanishing.** -/

name: isCommensurable_completion
statement:
theorem isCommensurable_completion (π : K) [hv.v.IsCommensurable π] :
    (Valued.v : Valuation (UniformSpace.Completion K) Γ₀).IsCommensurable
      (π : UniformSpace.Completion K)
doc:
/-- **Commensurability passes to the completion**: every value of the completion is a value of the
field, so a normalising element of `K` is a normalising element of its completion. -/

name: normAddVal_algebraMap
statement: theorem normAddVal_algebraMap (x : K) : normAddVal L (algebraMap K L x) = normAddVal K x
doc: /-- The real additive valuation of `L` restricts to that of `K`. -/

name: exists_normAddValZ_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_normAddValZ_algebraMap_eq {π : K} (hπ : IsUniformizer (valuation (K := K)) π) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, 0 < e ∧ normAddValZ L (algebraMap K L π) = ((e : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
doc:
/-- The image of a uniformiser of `K` has a positive integral additive valuation in `L`: the
ramification index of `L/K`. -/

name: normAddValZ_algebraMap
doc:
/-- **The ramification formula**: if a uniformiser of `K` has additive valuation `e` in `L`, then on
`K` the `ℤ`-valued additive valuation of `L` is `e` times that of `K`. -/

name: isCommensurable_algebraMap_of_isRankOneDiscrete
doc: /-- The image of a uniformiser of `K` is a normalising element of `L`. -/

name: map_intCast_normAddValZ_eq_map_normAddValQ
doc:
/-- **`normAddValZ L` is `e` times the `ℚ`-valued valuation of `L` normalised at a uniformiser of
`K`**, where `e` is the ramification index. -/

name: norm_pow_natDegree_minpoly
statement:
theorem norm_pow_natDegree_minpoly [CompleteSpace K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] (x : L) :
    ‖x‖ ^ (minpoly K x).natDegree = ‖(minpoly K x).coeff 0‖
doc:
/-- **The norm of an algebraic element is read off its minimal polynomial**: for the minimal
polynomial `Xⁿ + ⋯ + a₀` of `x`, `‖x‖ ^ n = ‖a₀‖` (BGR 3.2.4/3). -/

name: isCommensurable_algebraMap
statement:
instance isCommensurable_algebraMap [CompleteSpace K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] (π : K)
    [(valuation (K := K)).IsCommensurable π] :
    (valuation (K := L)).IsCommensurable (algebraMap K L π)
doc:
/-- **Commensurability is inherited by algebraic extensions**: if `K` is commensurable at `π`, then
`L` is commensurable at `algebraMap K L π`. -/

name: normAddValQ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem normAddValQ_algebraMap [CompleteSpace K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] (π : K)
    [(valuation (K := K)).IsCommensurable π] (x : K) :
    normAddValQ L (algebraMap K L π) (algebraMap K L x) = normAddValQ K π x
doc:
/-- The `ℚ`-valued additive valuation of `L` normalised at `algebraMap K L π` restricts to the
`ℚ`-valued additive valuation of `K` normalised at `π`. -/

name: isCommensurable_natCast_prime
statement:
instance isCommensurable_natCast_prime {L : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField L]
    [IsUltrametricDist L] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[p] L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ_[p] L] :
    (valuation (K := L)).IsCommensurable (p : L)
doc: /-- Every algebraic ultrametric normed `ℚ_p`-algebra field is commensurable at `p`. -/

name: isCommensurable_p
statement: theorem isCommensurable_p : (valuation (K := PadicAlgCl p)).IsCommensurable (p : PadicAlgCl p)
doc: /-- The valuation of the algebraic closure of `ℚ_p` is commensurable at `p`. -/

name: valuation_eq_nnnorm
statement: theorem valuation_eq_nnnorm (x : ℂ_[p]) : Valued.v x = ‖x‖₊
doc:
/-- The valuation of `ℂ_[p]` extended from the algebraic closure is the valuation read off the
norm. -/

name: normedField_valuation_eq
statement: theorem normedField_valuation_eq : (valuation (K := ℂ_[p])) = (PadicComplex.valued p).v

name: isCommensurable_p
statement: instance isCommensurable_p : (valuation (K := ℂ_[p])).IsCommensurable (p : ℂ_[p])
doc:
/-- **The valuation of `ℂ_p` is commensurable at `p`**: the `ℚ`-valued additive valuation
`normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p` exists. -/

name: normAddValQ_p
statement: theorem normAddValQ_p : normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p p = 1
doc: /-- The normalisation `normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p p = 1`. -/

name: normAddValQ_algebraMap_padic
statement:
theorem normAddValQ_algebraMap_padic (x : ℚ_[p]) :
    normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p (algebraMap ℚ_[p] ℂ_[p] x)
      = WithTop.map (fun n : ℤ ↦ (n : ℚ)) (Padic.addValuation x)
doc:
/-- On `ℚ_p`, the `ℚ`-valued additive valuation of `ℂ_p` normalised at `p` is `Padic.addValuation`
composed with `Int.cast`. -/

name: norm_eq_rpow_neg_normAddValQ
statement:
theorem norm_eq_rpow_neg_normAddValQ {x : ℂ_[p]} {q : ℚ}
    (hq : normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p x = (q : WithTop ℚ)) : ‖x‖ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-(q : ℝ))
doc: /-- **Norm recovery on `ℂ_p`**: `‖x‖ = p ^ (-(normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p x))`. -/

name: exists_normAddValQ_eq
statement:
theorem exists_normAddValQ_eq (q : ℚ) :
    ∃ x : ℂ_[p], x ≠ 0 ∧ normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p x = (q : WithTop ℚ)
doc: /-- Every rational number is the additive valuation of a nonzero element of `ℂ_p`. -/

name: range_normAddValQ
statement:
theorem range_normAddValQ :
    Set.range (normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p) = insert ⊤ (Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → WithTop ℚ))
doc:
/-- **The value group of `ℂ_p` is exactly `p^ℚ`**: the additive valuation takes every rational
value and, apart from `⊤` at `0`, nothing else. -/

name: normAddValZ_padic_p
statement: theorem normAddValZ_padic_p : normAddValZ ℚ_[p] (p : ℚ_[p]) = 1
doc: /-- `normAddValZ p = 1` on `ℚ_p`. -/

name: normAddValZ_padic_inv_p_sq
statement:
theorem normAddValZ_padic_inv_p_sq :
    normAddValZ ℚ_[p] ((p : ℚ_[p]) ^ 2)⁻¹ = ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
doc: /-- `normAddValZ (1 / p²) = -2` on `ℚ_p`. -/

name: normAddVal_padic
statement:
theorem normAddVal_padic (x : ℚ_[p]) :
    normAddVal ℚ_[p] x
      = WithTop.map (fun k : ℤ ↦ (k : ℝ) * Real.log p) (normAddValZ ℚ_[p] x)
doc: /-- `normAddVal ℚ_[p]` is `log p` times `normAddValZ ℚ_[p]`. -/

name: normAddValQ_of_sq_eq_prime
statement:
theorem normAddValQ_of_sq_eq_prime {s : L} (hs : s ^ 2 = p) :
    normAddValQ L p s = ((1 / 2 : ℚ) : WithTop ℚ)
doc: /-- A square root of `p` has `ℚ`-valued additive valuation `1/2` (normalised at `p`). -/

name: normAddValZ_prime_of_sq_eq_prime
statement:
theorem normAddValZ_prime_of_sq_eq_prime [(valuation (K := L)).IsRankOneDiscrete] {s : L}
    (hs : s ^ 2 = p) (h1 : normAddValZ L s = 1) : normAddValZ L (p : L) = 2
doc:
/-- In a discretely valued field in which a square root `s` of `p` has `ℤ`-valued additive
valuation `1`, `p` has `ℤ`-valued additive valuation `2`. -/

name: normAddValQ_padicComplex_of_pow_three
statement:
theorem normAddValQ_padicComplex_of_pow_three {x : ℂ_[p]} (hx : x ^ 3 = p) :
    normAddValQ ℂ_[p] p x = ((1 / 3 : ℚ) : WithTop ℚ)
doc: /-- In `ℂ_p`, a cube root of `p` has additive valuation `1/3`. -/

name: addValZ_X_pow
statement:
theorem addValZ_X_pow (n : ℕ) :
    addValZ (Valued.v : Valuation (LaurentSeries K) ℤᵐ⁰)
      (((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) : LaurentSeries K) ^ n) = ((n : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
doc: /-- `X ^ n` has `ℤ`-valued additive valuation `n`: the order of vanishing at `X`. -/
